reviewNotes: All labels concern retained reference content only, not real-world truth, publisher authority, accessibility or independence.
Genre/source authenticity cannot be inferred merely from a genuine-source marker. Concise cases are flagged so the binary substantive/non-substantive boundary is adjudicated before provider output.
Do not silently equate page length, scientific citations or a named experiment with substantive content; ordinary reference descriptions can be substantive.
